observations.source_title: Amana 18/30/45/60/90 Degree V-Groove Speed Chart v2 (AMS-159)
observations.ap_rule: 1xD use recommended chip load; 2xD reduce chip load 25%; 3xD reduce 50%
observations.machine_assumption: chart at 18000 rpm, doc 1x tool diameter; chart row labeled 'Hard Plastic'
observations.notes: B4 (2026-09-25): the AMS-159 chart prints no cutting diameter, so diameter_mm is null and the row is keyed at its printed angle. SKU 45771 has a 1/4 in (6.35 mm) body (the diameter_mm this row held before B4). rpm_nominal is the printed header 'Operating RPM: 18,000', which covers every material column.

observations.source_title: Amana Spektra 15/30/45/120 Degree Engraving Speed Chart v4
observations.ap_rule: 1xD use recommended feed rate; 2xD reduce feed rate 25%; 3xD reduce 50%
observations.machine_assumption: chart at 18000 rpm, doc 1x tool diameter; chart row labeled 'Hard Plastic'; 45 deg tip width 0.042 in
observations.notes: B4 (2026-09-25): the Spektra engraving v4 chart prints no cutting diameter, so diameter_mm is null and the row is keyed at its printed angle. SKU body 1/4 in (6.35 mm), the tool's shank (the diameter_mm this row held before B4). rpm_nominal is the printed header 'CNC Operating Spindle Speed: 18,000 RPM', which covers every material column.
